prompts.lemur:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: FOUR complete character originals for a toddler rainforest game.
A friendly BLACK-AND-WHITE RUFFED LEMUR, Madagascar forest animal, with black face, modest warm eyes, a soft white neck/shoulder ruff, patchy black-and-white torso, black hands/feet, long black tail. Do NOT give a raccoon face or ringed tail. Strong simplified matte softly faceted 3D children's illustration, no photographic fur or hair detail, no scary face, no huge chibi head.
Exactly TWO columns TWO rows FOUR equal cells, fixed LEFT-facing three-quarter side camera. Same gentle individual, same head/body size and black/white marks, same small horizontal branch drawn below feet in each cell, branch angle horizontal. Full tail and all limbs inside12%empty margins, no crossing seams.
0: crouches calmly perched on the branch, both hands hold branch naturally.
1: holds branch with one hand and raises the other in a gentle wave, elbow naturally bent.
2: wave hand lowers; takes one SMALL deliberate climbing step along branch, near hand reaches ahead, opposite hindfoot lifts slightly.
3: returns to a relaxed perch with limbs firmly attached. Keep pelvis/camera registration and branch mostly same, do not jump or stretch body.
Paint whole connected animals each time, visible fingers remain few stylized shapes. True transparent alpha, no shadow, text, border, grid, scenery or backdrop. Reference image 1 is only the desired matte low-poly material warmth, not species identity.
prompts.peacock:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: FOUR complete original bird drawings for a toddler rainforest game.
One friendly male INDIAN PEAFOWL (peacock), rich royal-blue neck/head, small upright crest, warm natural modest eyes, olive-green folded wing, spectacular green eye-spotted train. Matte simplified softly faceted 3D children's wildlife illustration, broad clean sculpted shapes, no photographic feather microdetail, no giant chibi head.
Exactly TWO columns TWO rows FOUR equal SQUARE cells, fixed three-quarter LEFT-facing camera. The same whole bird, head/body/feet size, pose and colour marks in each cell. Feet baseline at84% of cell, body at50% width. Allow expanded tail train big but FULLY inside12% margin on all sides, no crossing cells, no clipped train.
0: train CLOSED and draped behind, relaxed standing bird.
1: train half-raised and partly spread, body/neck position invariant.
2: beautiful FULL FAN open behind bird, stylized eye-pattern rings, natural peacock train not a flat rainbow cartoon semicircle, small wing visible and two attached legs. Cheerful gentle face.
3: train partly folded back toward rest, same body and feet.
Create one complete connected illustration for each state, no pasted detachable feathers. Same character scale across cells, do not shrink the fullfan bird. True transparent alpha, no ground or shadow, text, numbers, frame/grid or scenery. Reference image1 is only softly faceted children's rendering style, not species identity.
